info.description: List pagination for row/card lists: keep `Items to show` items visible and reveal the rest with an editable Show more/less toggle — or switch it off to list everything (and expose the section's button instead)

useShowMore.description: On: keep `Items to show` items visible, reveal the rest with the toggle. Off: list every item and use the section's button instead.

loadChunk.description: How many items each click on Show more reveals (client-side). Ignored by sections that reveal everything at once.

pageSize.description: How many items each server page holds when the list keeps loading from Strapi.
